Medium-wide eye-level shot on a 35mm lens, composed for 16:9. Scarlett (Image 1) strides toward the camera through a narrow downtown apartment hallway, one hand holding an open coral lipstick and the other carrying a natural canvas tote, caught just before snapping the tube shut. Scarlett (Image 1)’s weight is pitched forward, eyes focused toward the building exit, with clear space ahead for movement. A muted gray radiator and continuous shelf run along the wall behind Scarlett (Image 1), with the forgotten phone resting visibly on the shelf. Warm cream plaster walls and soft morning daylight create even illumination. Bright naturalistic editorial social-first beauty style, clean true-to-life color, lifted shadows, vivid coral accent.
